Goal of the hook is to catch the attention of the reader and introduce the reader to the problem.
Hook is ok. Not binding but acceptable. Instead of 49% feeling positively challenged reverse it for more impact "51% not positively challenged". Instead of 11% strongly feels... say for more impact "89% do not strongly feel..."

Correct observation but still feels to generalized. In order to make the hook more impactful again use for example the consequences for students that are lagging behind to highlight how strong the effect is on the lives of these students showcasing the importance of your problem

- Goal: anchor shows how the problem was dealt so far, the domain of the problem, relevance in academia and highlighting the deficits of the current literature.
What is new that we need more research? Good to show examples but what is new that is not already available today?

A source is being cited to show highlight a problem in present LLMs but looking up the source the source writes about reducing datasets to finetune the LLMs. You can search for other sources addressing the problems you mentioned

You show the discrepancy between the existing research work and yours. An improvement would be to position your research more distinctively by explaining that your research is about LLM-based teacher as comprehensive learning agents showing that you are inspecting another element of the topic that other works also worked on
Although it is not bad to use pronouns it is recommended to stay as objective as possible and use formulations like "A mixed method of qualitative... will be used." instead of "We will use..."

Here can be potential difficulties. This is the chance to mention those e.g. "While fine-tuning the LLM model it could be that a bias is introduced." and also address them "Although the risk exist by breaking up the amount of parameters into a smaller subset of parameters the chance of introducing a bias can be reduced."

Depending on the level of educations the students have the LLM agent could show results of improved learning. You should restrict the testing audience to high school and above since students below this education level won't be able to use a provided LLM agent as effective as the one's above this education level
